# 04 `classDef`, `class`, and the `:::` shorthand

## Outcome

A flowchart author defines a named style once and applies it to many nodes, either with a `class`
statement or with `A[Label]:::name` at the declaration itself.

## Why this ticket exists

`style` styles one node. Everything an author does more than once needs a definition they can
name — which is what `classDef` is for, and it is the directive `color` will be written in when
ticket 06 lands.

`class` and `:::` are one feature with two spellings, not two features: both apply a `classDef` to
a node, and they differ only in where the author writes it. Splitting them across tickets would
mean two workers building the same lookup.

**Mermaid's flowchart directive is `class`, not `cssClass`.** `cssClass` is class-diagram-only, and
ticket 01 normalized both spellings to one canonical kind — use it rather than adding a third.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `classDef name <prop>:<value>,...` defines a named property set and applies to nothing on its
      own.
- [x] `class A,B name` applies a definition to each listed node. A definition may be applied to
      many nodes and a node may carry many definitions.
- [x] `A[Start]:::name` and the bare `A:::name` apply a definition at the node declaration. Assert
      both forms, and assert `:::` on a node that also appears in an edge.
- [x] A `classDef` may be defined *after* the statement that applies it — resolution is a pass of
      its own, exactly as it is for the class diagram. Assert the forward reference.
- [x] Applying a definition that no `classDef` defines is an error diagnostic naming it, and the
      other targets of `class A,Ghost name` still get styled.
- [x] Ordering follows ADR-0008: `style`, `classDef` and the apply-directive flatten into one
      ordered list per node, last declaration of a property winning. Assert a `style` and a
      `classDef` disagreeing about the same property.
- [x] All of it goes through the shared resolver from ticket 01. `buildFlowchartModel` gains no
      resolution rules of its own.
- [x] Do **not** implement `linkStyle`. Ticket 05 owns it.
